# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityKSPeersPairsTradingAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        for ticker in ["KO", "PEP"]:
            equity = self.add_equity(ticker)
            # Minute-resolution data, but trade on a daily basis.
            equity.spread = IndicatorExtensions.minus(equity.price, equity.peers['KO'].price if ticker == "PEP" else equity.peers['PEP'].price)
            # Use a rolling window to calculate the z-score of the spread.
            equity.z_score = self.z_score(equity.spread, 60, Resolution.DAILY)
            # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
            # equity.z_score = ZeroOneMeanReversionIndicator(60)
            # self.warm_up_indicator(ticker, equity.z_score, Resolution.DAILY)
            # self.register_indicator(ticker, equity.z_score, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.week_start("KO"),
            self.time_rules.at(9, 31),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        for security in self.securities.values():
            if not security.z_score.is_ready:
                continue
            z_score = security.z_score.current.value
            weight = security.holdings.weight
            absolute_z_score = abs(z_score)
            if not security.holdings.is_any and absolute_z_score > 2:
                target_weight = 0.5 if z_score < 0 else -0.5
                self.set_holdings(security, target_weight)
            elif security.holdings.is_any and absolute_z_score < 0.5:
                self.liquidate(security)
